title: Negotiating a Contract
subtitle: Discussing terms with a vendor — for English learners

sentences.en: Thanks for sending over the revised draft — I've had a chance to review the key provisions.
sentences.target: Thanks for sending over the revised draft — I've had a chance to review the key provisions.

sentences.en: Overall the structure works for us, but there are a few clauses I'd like to revisit before we sign.
sentences.target: Overall the structure works for us, but there are a few clauses I'd like to revisit before we sign.

sentences.en: Of course — which sections in particular are you concerned about?
sentences.target: Of course — which sections in particular are you concerned about?

sentences.en: The termination clause requires ninety days' notice, but our standard internal policy is sixty.
sentences.target: The termination clause requires ninety days' notice, but our standard internal policy is sixty.

sentences.en: We could meet in the middle at seventy-five days, provided the cancellation fee remains the same.
sentences.target: We could meet in the middle at seventy-five days, provided the cancellation fee remains the same.

sentences.en: That's reasonable — we can accept seventy-five days if the indemnification cap stays at one year of fees.
sentences.target: That's reasonable — we can accept seventy-five days if the indemnification cap stays at one year of fees.

sentences.en: We're also asking for stronger language around data ownership and the return of materials post-engagement.
sentences.target: We're also asking for stronger language around data ownership and the return of materials post-engagement.

sentences.en: We can agree to that, as long as the return obligation is limited to documents produced under this agreement.
sentences.target: We can agree to that, as long as the return obligation is limited to documents produced under this agreement.

sentences.en: Finally, the late-payment interest rate seems high — could we reduce it from one-point-five percent to one percent monthly?
sentences.target: Finally, the late-payment interest rate seems high — could we reduce it from one-point-five percent to one percent monthly?

sentences.en: We'll accept one percent if you agree to net-thirty payment terms instead of net-forty-five.
sentences.target: We'll accept one percent if you agree to net-thirty payment terms instead of net-forty-five.

sentences.en: Done. I'll have our counsel mark up the document this week and send it back for final signatures.
sentences.target: Done. I'll have our counsel mark up the document this week and send it back for final signatures.

sentences.en: Excellent. I think we've reached a fair arrangement on both sides — looking forward to working together.
sentences.target: Excellent. I think we've reached a fair arrangement on both sides — looking forward to working together.
